# Research Report: Next-Generation Battery Chemistries

## Executive Summary
Silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries achieve gravimetric energy densities reaching 400 Wh/kg, but suffer from 300% volumetric expansion during lithiation [chunk_energy_01].

## Solid-State Advances
Solid-state electrolyte interfaces using sulfide ceramic separators reduce dendrite penetration at current densities up to 10 mA/cm2 under 5 MPa stack pressure [chunk_energy_02].

## Strategic Synthesis
In our strategic analysis, mass production scaling hinges on mechanical pressure containment solutions.
